messages:
Sam: kicking off tri-region wave (US -> EU -> APAC). plan: pin v2.3.1 in US for 12m, run smoke + perf checks, then soft-roll EU, finally APAC warmup. keeping canary traffic small.
Jia: noted. what's our target p95 and token throughput thresholds for the canary?
Sam: p95 <= 180ms and token/sec >= 85% of baseline. if either deviates >20% we pause.
Marco: current warm pools: US 92% available, EU 70% (warming), APAC 45% (cold). will add 2x warm workers to APAC now.
deploy-bot: deploy request accepted. initiating canary: service=redwood-inference, model=v2.3.1, region=us, slice=canary, traffic=3%
deploy-bot: logs: created revision r-2027-031. routing rules applied.
ops-bot: quick perf snapshot (1m ago): US p95=172ms, p50=60ms, tokens/s=8800 (baseline 9200) :thumbsup:
Jia: can we verify KV cache hit ratio for canary requests? last time cold APAC caused big token regen.
Marco: cache-hit (canary US): 87%. KV reuse looks healthy.
Anika: rollback criteria: (1) p95>220ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR (2) error-rate >0.5% sustained for 2 mins OR (3) token/sec <70% baseline. agree?
Sam: agree. set automated hold action to notify on first breach, auto-pause on second.
deploy-bot: EU soft-roll starting: region=eu, traffic=8%, model=v2.3.1. pin window=10m for EU.
ops-bot: EU warmup note: some nodes still completing quantization step (logs show GPU memory spikes ~2s per init). monitoring.
Marco: ramped APAC warm pool to 70% — still under target but improving.
ops-bot: EU perf (first 3m): p95=195ms, tokens/s=8100 (baseline EU 9000), error-rate=0.12%
Jia: EU p95 creeping toward threshold. keeping EU pin at 10m then reevaluate.
Sam: hold APAC push until EU pin clears. do a quick canary smoke in APAC with traffic=1% once EU green.
deploy-bot: APAC canary queued. awaiting manual GO from Sam.
Anika: suggestion: for APAC, enable prefix cache prewarm for top-100 prompt clusters to reduce cold token regen. small script: ```python
# prewarm heads
for prompt in top100:
  call_rpc('prewarm', prompt)
```
Marco: running prewarm now (estimated 4-5m).
ops-bot: alert (automated): EU p95 spike at t+11m => 260ms for 90s. tagging for review.
Sam: pausing EU rollout, initiating quick investigate. roll back EU slice to previous variant if not resolved in 4m.
Jia: copying metrics to replay workspace and running sample traces. attaching logs: `s3://redwood-logs/deploy/1775512345/eu-spike/`
deploy-bot: EU slice reverted to r-2027-030 (previous stable). traffic back to 100% on stable variant.
ops-bot: post-rollback EU perf: p95=168ms, error-rate=0.04%, tokens/s=9050 :white_check_mark:
Sam: good. cancel APAC manual GO for now. we'll re-run the tri-wave tomorrow in the 06:00 UTC change window after extra prewarm.
Anika: filing short post-deploy note and rollback reasoning. recommend adding APAC prewarm job to the rollout playbook.
Marco: noted — I'll open a follow-up ticket to add prewarm and a small thermal hedging config for APAC.
Sam: thanks team. TL;DR: US canary ok, EU rollback after p95 spike, APAC postponed; next attempt 06:00 UTC with prewarm + 2x warmers. :thumbsup:
